summary: Genmab A/S filed a Form 6-K furnishing Company Announcement no. 48, a routine Regulation (EU) 596/2014 Article 19 managerial-transaction disclosure. It reports that Executive Vice President and Chief Commercial Officer Bradley Bailey sold 1,071 Genmab shares (ISIN DK0010272202) on 2026-11-11 on Nasdaq Copenhagen across prices from DKK 3,592.00 to DKK 3,625.00, aggregating DKK 3,602.98 per share. No board recommendation, advisor, stake, premium, or structural deal terms are stated. This is an ordinary insider-trading notice with no special-situation or risk-arb angle; watch only routine insider-sale patterns.
